issues.item: Avoid Religious Spaces: Places of worship or religious gatherings
issues.explanation: This avoidance item is not well supported by the rest of the profile. The triggers, memory, and negative appraisal items center on military-context reminders, confrontation, injuries, grief, unreality, and alienation, but nothing else suggests a trauma-linked religious context. In this profile it stands out as a clinically hard-to-explain avoidance target rather than a coherent extension of the identified triggers or appraisals.

'Being in Nature' is a plausible military-related trigger, but it does not cohere well with the selected coping profile and the rest of the networked content. The other trigger items focus on confrontation and visible injuries, whereas no other node reflects transport-related settings or a civilian commuting context.

'Avoid Public Transport' is the clearest incoherent item. Nothing in the trigger, memory, or appraisal items suggests buses, trains, crowds, confinement, or travel-related danger. For this profile, avoidance is otherwise organized around military cues ('Avoid Uniform or Weapons') and trauma-linked emotional/cognitive responses. Public-transport avoidance appears disconnected from the rest of the formulation and is hard to explain as part of the same trauma-linked pattern.
